verses.text: These are the words of Amos, one of the shepherds from Tekoa. This is what he saw about Israel two years before the earthquake, when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Joash was king of Israel.
He said: "The LORD roars from Zion and thunders from Jerusalem. The pastures of the shepherds dry up, and the top of Mount Carmel withers."
This is what the LORD says: "The people of Damascus have sinned again and again, and I will not hold back their punishment. They crushed the people of Gilead with iron threshing sledges.
So I will send fire on the house of Hazael, and it will burn down the fortresses of Ben Hadad.

I will break down the gate bars of Damascus. I will destroy the king who lives in the Valley of Aven and the one who holds the scepter in Beth Eden. The people of Aram will be taken as captives to Kir," says the LORD.
This is what the LORD says: "The people of Gaza have sinned again and again, and I will not hold back their punishment. They captured whole communities and sold them to Edom.
So I will send fire on the walls of Gaza, and it will burn down its fortresses.
I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the one who holds the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn my hand against Ekron, and the last of the Philistines will die," says the Lord GOD.
This is what the LORD says: "The people of Tyre have sinned again and again, and I will not hold back their punishment. They sold whole communities to Edom and broke their treaty of brotherhood.
So I will send fire on the walls of Tyre, and it will burn down its fortresses."

This is what the LORD says: "The people of Edom have sinned again and again, and I will not hold back their punishment. They chased their brother Israel with the sword and showed no mercy. Their anger raged on and on, and they never let go of their fury.
So I will send fire on Teman, and it will burn down the fortresses of Bozrah."
This is what the LORD says: "The people of Ammon have sinned again and again, and I will not hold back their punishment. To make their land larger, they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead.
So I will set fire to the walls of Rabbah, and it will burn down its fortresses. There will be war cries on the day of battle, and a violent storm on the day of the whirlwind.
Their king will go into exile, he and his officials together," says the LORD.
